- `read()` now consumes JSON `null` and returns `null` instead of attempting to parse it as a string (DefaultDateTypeAdapter.java:379)

- `DefaultDateTypeAdapterTest#testNullValue` (was failing at baseline) now passes
- `GsonBuilderTest` passes (4/4)
- End-to-end reproduction of the issue now works: `new GsonBuilder().setDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd").create().toJson(personWithNullDate)` prints `{}` instead of throwing NPE; date formatting and null deserialization both behave correctly
- The remaining `DefaultDateTypeAdapterTest` failures (locale-dependent formatting, `testUnexpectedToken`) were verified pre-existing at baseline via `git stash` and are unrelated to this fix
